description: This file defines the DownloadController class and related classes for managing downloadable items, including persistence, state management, and interface with download engine and database for a Flutter application.

classes.name: DownloadItem
classes.description: Represents a downloadable item with its metadata and status.

classes.name: DownloadController
classes.description: Manages download queues, persistence, and interaction with download engine within the app.

methods.name: restoreFromDisk
methods.description: Restores download queue and item states from SQLite database.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download item to the queue and starts download if applicable.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a download item and cancels any ongoing download.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the global download queue pause state.

methods.name: resumeItem
methods.description: Resumes a specific paused download item.
